characters.description: A farmer, Candle Scholar Tower mage, and leader of the Eternal Flame. He returns from the Millennium Meeting as a recognized dragon slayer and rejects the Resplendent Empress's attempt to make peace.
characters.name: John

characters.description: John's wife and partner, a powerful mage who ascended alongside him during the Millennium Meeting. She returns at his side and briefly falls under the Resplendent Empress's glamour before John frees her.
characters.name: Ellie

characters.description: The world spirit who administers and defends the Valley. She oversees its quest and resurrection systems and directs exploration.
characters.name: Rabia

characters.description: John's bull companion and a formidable ally. Alongside John and Ellie, he helped stop the hostile coalition from claiming the war god's domain during the Millennium Meeting.
characters.name: Ferdie

characters.description: John's former mentor and a trusted farmhand. John releases him from hired work and offers him land in the Valley, giving Thomas the opportunity to establish a farm and home of his own.
characters.name: Thomas

characters.description: A puppet guide who escorts John and Ellie to the Millennium Meeting prize room. The guide explains their resource worlds, library token, and challenger qualification.
characters.name: the Millennium Meeting puppet guide

characters.description: A self-aware puppet guide associated with Millennium City. Already known to John and Ellie from an earlier visit, he receives them when they return using Ellie's platinum library token.
characters.name: Kevin

characters.description: Ferdie's partner, who is pregnant when John gathers the Valley's allies for the coming war. She stands with Ferdie as the beast forces prepare to support the campaign.
characters.name: the Beast King

characters.description: The true-dragon ruler of the Resplendent Empire and sister of a dragon John previously killed. She approaches him with an offer of peace, but he rejects the proposal and confirms that their war will continue.
characters.name: the Resplendent Empress

characters.description: A powerful dragonkin forge authority in Elmra and the forge overseer's daughter. She takes charge of John's slave group for dangerous blade experiments that appear to consume prisoners.
characters.name: the female dragonkin

characters.description: A human bodyguard serving an influential dragonkin woman in Elmra. Though he protects her publicly, he quietly saves prisoners from her dangerous experiments and directs the survivors into forge labor.
characters.name: the female dragonkin's bodyguard

characters.description: A guard captain who survives John's attempt to free him from draconic corruption. He conceals the portal incident, escorts John to Port Clay, and becomes a local aide in the infiltration.
characters.name: the freed Persis guard captain

characters.description: The Port Clay official who survives purification and willingly joins John to seek revenge against the Empire for his family's destruction. John appoints him acting slave master and places the city's slave operation under his control.
characters.name: the Port Clay vice slave master

characters.description: The ruler of Elmra's forge system and father of an ambitious dragonkin smith. He mistakes John for a returning rival dragon, reveals his descent from that dragon's surviving bloodline, and agrees to help organize a coup.
characters.name: the Elmra forge overseer

characters.description: A senior Imperial investigator dispatched to Elmra after its expanding legion attracts suspicion. He leads an inspection of the forge overseer's activities and represents a serious threat to the concealed uprising.
characters.name: the High Inquisitor

characters.description: The forge overseer's dragonkin daughter, driven by a determination to become a capable blacksmith. She knowingly accepts a potentially fatal Eternal Flame transformation for the chance to advance her craft.
characters.name: Lucia

characters.description: A former enemy-team leader who has become a devil and leads an Abyssal force into Resplendent under the Empress's pact. He invokes a greater power through a blood covenant and demands John's destruction.
characters.name: the enemy elven supreme mage

characters.description: A returning allied spellcaster whom John appoints as his representative to organize Resplendent alongside Rabia after the world joins his divine kingdom.
characters.name: John's Resplendent representative

characters.description: A dragonkin ally appointed to govern Elmra and the former Resplendent Empire. As emperor of the renamed Eternal Empire, he administers its worlds with a dragonkin council.
characters.name: the Eternal Empire emperor

characters.description: The head librarian's husband and John and Ellie's guide through Millennium City. He describes the titan-built city, its library and research districts, and the long cycle governing the Magical Millennium Meeting.
characters.name: the Millennium City guide

characters.description: The head librarian of Millennium City and the guide's wife. She confirms that both she and her husband came from Earth long ago and invites John and Ellie to seek answers about titan creations and their old world.
characters.name: Mina

characters.description: John's younger brother and his closest family connection on Earth. He runs the family cheese shop with his wife Sarah and their daughter Nora, and has lived with an official explanation for John's disappearance.
characters.name: Isaac

characters.description: The authority responsible for Earth's protection and for maintaining magic, faith miracles, and the Endless Worlds. The Administrator permits John and Ellie one tightly limited Earth visit in return for a future service.
characters.name: the Prime Administrator

characters.description: A fundamental law bonded to the Millennium City guide, who serves as its anchor. It explains that personal ties help aspects preserve their identities. Its authority can rewrite reality by revising the past itself.
characters.name: the truth aspect

characters.description: A deity with knowledge of aspects and the powers operating beyond ordinary worlds. The raven god explains how the Eternal Flame could let its bearer consume divinities and eventually embody a fundamental law.
characters.name: the raven god

characters.description: A guide who accompanies John and Ellie into the battlefield. He explains the danger posed by the Unmaking, including crystal entities capable of inhabiting dead dragon bodies and resisting ordinary attacks.
characters.name: the raven god's associate

characters.description: An aspect-powered fighter who intervenes at the battlefield's final wall against a dragon corpse overrun by hostile crystal.
characters.name: the aspect of change avatar

characters.description: A tower keeper who had custody of an Unmaking corpse. John finds hidden crystal threaded through her body and tower, with the growth influencing her mind as the wider site is placed under lockdown.
characters.name: the Candle Scholar Tower master

characters.description: A woman pursuing a relationship with Thomas. They plan to share the home and farm he is establishing in the Valley.
characters.name: Thomas's partner
